answers.workaround: No, as fog is implemented in the renderer itself and can't be overridden for all materials at once. https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/41415 allows overriding fog on a per-material basis, but this means people would have to use their custom materials everywhere instead of BaseMaterial3D.

title: Add a hard cutoff property to Environment fixed fog (for open world fog fading)
